JOB: Professional, Manufacturing Engineering
COMPANY: Bombardier
SOURCE: LinkedIn, Dorval QC, 2026-10-16 (from the progress presentation, trimmed)

What are your contributions to the team?
Manage facility layout and workspace reconfiguration projects
Lead continuous improvement and industrialization projects
Facilitate Kaizen workshops to implement solutions and engage operational teams
Develop and obtain approval for facility and production layouts
Monitor and follow up on equipment and facility implementation plans
Support 5S deployment and sustainment activities
Analyze production capacity and define equipment and tooling requirements
Develop business cases to support capital investments and acquisitions
Create and maintain equipment and tooling inventories
Map and optimize processes related to equipment and tooling management

How to thrive in this role?
You hold a College Diploma (DEC) or a Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering.
You have a minimum of 2 years of experience in a manufacturing/production environment, including experience in facility layout management and tooling.
You possess strong abilities to communicate, simplify concepts, and translate complex tasks into practical solutions.
You demonstrate strong organizational skills, attention to detail, initiative, and autonomy.
You are a strong team player.
You demonstrate leadership, patience, perseverance, curiosity, and a willingness to take on challenges.
You are proficient with Excel and PowerPoint; knowledge of AutoCAD is considered an asset.
You have knowledge of the aerospace industry.
You are able to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing, in French; English is considered an asset.
Please note: You don’t need all the skills, knowledge, and experience listed to apply for this position. We’re not looking for the perfect candidate, we’re looking for great talent and passionate individuals.
